dental.title: Payment options
dental.body_text: We accept cash and all major credit cards. Payment plans of 6 or 12 months are available for treatments over $500 through CareCredit.

dental.title: Dental emergencies
dental.body_text: For dental emergencies during opening hours call 555-0100 and we will fit you in the same day. Out of hours call the emergency line 555-0199.

dental.title: Children
dental.body_text: We see children from age 3. The first visit for a child is a 30 minute check-up costing $60.

dental.title: Services and prices
dental.body_text: Check-up $90, cleaning $120, fillings from $150, root canal from $800. Invisalign consultations are free.

bakery.title: Allergen information
bakery.body_text: Our cakes may contain milk, eggs, wheat, soy and tree nuts. The brownies contain walnuts. The vegan cake is made with oat milk and contains no eggs or dairy, but it is baked in a kitchen that also handles nuts.

bakery.title: Custom cake pricing
bakery.body_text: Custom cakes start at $45 for a 6 inch cake serving 8 people. A 3 tier wedding cake starts at $350.

bakery.title: Payment and deposits
bakery.body_text: We accept cash, cards and Apple Pay. A 50% deposit is required for custom orders.

bakery.title: Pickup
bakery.body_text: Orders can be picked up during opening hours. Please bring your order number.

bikes.title: Models
bikes.body_text: The Model X has a range of 80 km and costs $2,400. The Model Y has a range of 60 km and costs $1,900. Both come in sizes S, M and L.

bikes.title: Financing
bikes.body_text: We offer 0% financing over 12 months at checkout for orders above $1,000.

bikes.title: Battery care
bikes.body_text: Charge the battery at room temperature and do not leave it fully empty for more than a week. A battery replacement outside warranty costs $450.

salon.title: Services and prices
salon.body_text: Balayage from $180, keratin treatment $220, blow dry $40. Colour starts at $95.

salon.title: Stylists
salon.body_text: Our senior stylists are Mia and Jonas. Mia specialises in colour and Jonas in men's cuts.

salon.title: Products
salon.body_text: We use and sell Olaplex and Redken products. Gift cards are available in any amount at the front desk.

gym.title: Facilities
gym.body_text: We have a 25 metre pool, a sauna, free weights and 40 cardio machines. Towels are free.

gym.title: Personal training
gym.body_text: Personal training sessions cost $60 for one hour or $500 for ten sessions. Book at the front desk.

gym.title: Guests
gym.body_text: Members may bring a guest for $5 per visit. Guests must be 16 or older.

plumber.title: Services
plumber.body_text: We fix leaks, blocked drains, water heaters, toilets and taps. We also install dishwashers and washing machines.

plumber.title: Water heaters
plumber.body_text: A standard water heater replacement takes about 3 hours. Prices depend on the unit, and a written quote is given before work starts.

plumber.title: Working hours
plumber.body_text: Standard jobs are booked Monday to Saturday 8am to 6pm. Sunday work is only for emergencies.
